articles.title: A Space Telescope Opens Its Eyes After Eight Years
articles.summary: After eight years in space, the MIXS telescope on BepiColombo passed its first test by spotting the Crab Nebula more sharply than in lab tests, just before the mission enters orbit around Mercury.

articles.title: Physicists Spot a Super-Rare Particle Change
articles.summary: After more than 40 years of searching, CERN's upgraded LHCb experiment has found evidence of a particle decay that happens only once in every 10 billion tries.

articles.title: Yosemite Asks Visitors to Help Track River Otters
articles.summary: River otters have been spotted in Yosemite National Park, and rangers are asking visitors to report sightings to help track them across the park's 1,700 miles of streams.
